title: dysphania ambrosioides
intro: Dysphania ambrosioides, commonly known as Blite or Epazote, is a flowering plant in the amaranth family. It is often used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of gastrointestinal issues, such as flatulence, indigestion, and diarrhea, due to its carminative and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax muscles, reduce spasms, and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of Dysphania ambrosioides include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
